review_kind: agent visual inspection, with independent contrast calculation and separately identified automated evidence
method_limits: Every carousel was inspected as six-slide contact-sheet imagery, and every cover was inspected again on cover contact sheets. Contact sheets were shown through view_image; images were resized by the viewing surface.
Full-size visual checks covered the 13 selected PNGs listed below. This does not claim full-size proof-reading of every PNG or human visual approval.
Exact copy integrity, dimensions, overlap and font-use claims across all 1080 depend on separately identified machine evidence; visual observations do not replace those tests.
No clinical, legal, publication, audience-performance or autobiographical truth approval is granted.
visual_observations: All180 carousels show six distinct ordered slides with coherent charcoal/off-white treatments. No blank or missing slide was observed.
Main copy remains in one reading column, clear of headers, footer rules, brand name, handle and folio. No apparent clipping, overlap or missing-glyph boxes was observed.
Cover hooks use restrained editorial type. Body copy and safety caveats remain prominent. Full-size longest/difficult examples are readable.

Script examples retain framing such as Try/Where safe, and use typography rather than private-chat imitation. No photography, synthetic people, invented emblem, signature, watermark or visible planning date was observed.
The permitted plain-text Broken to Balanced footer is consistent. This is provisional branding pending the original approved logo.
No isolated single-word final line was observed on the contact sheets or selected full-size checks. Separate geometry evidence reports at least two words on all final lines.

independent_contrast.method: WCAG sRGB relative-luminance formula applied to all actual foreground/background RGB pairs in recorded DOM bounds, independently of renderer contrast report
independent_contrast.decorative_accents: Blue/sand rules are decorative; main message and identity text use charcoal/off-white.
